CameraSetting.description: Camera offsets on top of the avatar's own framing. Every field is optional and neutral when left out. A value outside its supported range is still applied, and the response lists a warning for it; NaN and infinity are a 422.

orbit_x_off.description: Degrees the camera orbits up over the avatar's head (elevation). Supported range -80 to 80.

orbit_y_off.description: Degrees the camera orbits round to its right (azimuth). Supported range -180 to 180.

pos_x_off.description: Moves the avatar right, in half canvas widths. Supported range -10 to 10.

pos_y_off.description: Moves the avatar down, in half canvas heights. Supported range -10 to 10.

pos_z_off.description: Metres the camera backs away from the avatar (negative moves in). Supported range -5 to 5.

rot_x_off.description: Degrees the camera tilts up (pitch). Supported range -180 to 180.

rot_y_off.description: Degrees the camera pans right (yaw). Supported range -180 to 180.

rot_z_off.description: Degrees the camera rolls clockwise. Supported range -180 to 180.

zoom.description: Multiplies the avatar's zoom; 1 is no change. Supported range above 0, up to 4.

CameraSetting.title: CameraSetting

created_at.description: Timestamp when the face was created

id.description: Unique identifier for the face, generated by the MySQL service

owner_id.description: Unique identifier for the owner of the face

simli_version.description: Version of the Simli model used for the face

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the face was last updated

avatar_position_x.description: Where the avatar sits across the canvas, from 0 (left) to 1 (right). Trinity-2 only.
avatar_position_x.title: Avatar Position X

avatar_position_y.description: Where the avatar sits down the canvas, from 0 (top) to 1 (bottom). Trinity-2 only.
avatar_position_y.title: Avatar Position Y

background_id.description: One of your uploaded backgrounds, by the id POST /assets/backgrounds returned, to show behind the avatar, cropped to fill the canvas. Trinity-2 only. Leave it out for the avatar's own. An id that is not one of your account's is dropped with a warning, and the session uses the avatar's own. An image is not accepted: upload it first. A streaming session can change it afterwards with BG_ messages.
background_id.title: Background Id

camera.description: The camera the session starts with, on top of the avatar's own framing. Trinity-2 only. Leave it out to keep the avatar's framing. A streaming session can move it afterwards with CAM_ messages.

foreground_id.description: One of your uploaded foregrounds, by the id POST /assets/foregrounds returned, laid over the avatar through its transparency and cropped to fill the canvas. Trinity-2 only; otherwise as background_id. A streaming session can change it afterwards with FG_ messages.
foreground_id.title: Foreground Id

streaming_height.description: Height of the streamed video in pixels. See streaming_width.
streaming_height.title: Streaming Height

streaming_width.description: Width of the streamed video in pixels, Trinity-2 faces only (the others keep their own frame size). At least 512, and with streaming_height one of 1:1, 16:9 or 9:16, otherwise a 422. A canvas larger than the avatar's frame is padded with its background; a smaller one crops a window out of it.
streaming_width.title: Streaming Width

info.title: Simli
info.x-cindra-note: Cut from https://api.simli.ai/openapi.yaml -- only what Cindra calls.

post.description: Create a temporary Simli Compose Session Token

warnings.description: Starting camera fields outside their supported range, region overrides, and background_id / foreground_id dropped as not your account's (the avatar's own is used). The token is minted regardless.
